title: Case No. 6615421 - Indecent Exposure
details: Victoria was caught having sex with a stranger in one of the dressing rooms. The stranger made their big escape, but Officer Dorian was able to get a hold of her. Once in the office, the guard tells her to take her shades off - immediately recognizing her as the famous actress Victoria Zdrok, someone who can’t really afford the bad publicity. Dorian threatens to tell the news outlets about this and to charge her with indecent exposure. Victoria begs for a backdoor exit–exactly what Dorian has in mind! Anal sex is the only way Victoria can keep this incident private.
